title: Oh No No No
blurb: The 'Oh No No No' laugh — the wheezing, escalating laughter that TikTok attaches to disasters in progress. It plays as the skateboard leaves the rail, as the cake begins to lean, as the plan visibly falls apart in real time. The laugh arriving before the impact is the entire art form. A fail-video institution.
origin: The viral laughing track played over slow-motion disasters on TikTok.
